description.en-US: Think Well On't, or Reflections on the great truths of the Christian religion for every day of the month (1728), Challoner's first and most reprinted devotional book: thirty-one days of short considerations on death, judgment, hell, heaven, the mercies of God and the Passion, with directions for the use of the considerations, rules for a Christian life and a short treatise on the life of faith.
description.pt-BR: Think Well On't — Reflexões sobre as grandes verdades da religião cristã para cada dia do mês (1728), o primeiro e mais reimpresso livro devocional de Challoner: trinta e um dias de breves considerações sobre a morte, o juízo, o inferno, o céu, as misericórdias de Deus e a Paixão, com instruções para o uso das considerações, regras de vida cristã e um breve tratado sobre a vida de fé.

en-US.editor: Bp. Richard Challoner (1801 edition, as transcribed on Wikisource)

sources.edition: Think Well On't, or Reflections on the great truths of the Christian religion for every day of the month (1801 edition), Wikisource transcription of Thinkwellonit.pdf.
sources.description: The thirty-one days, the directions, the rules for a Christian life and the Life of Faith. The days follow the book's own headings; the Wikisource page boundaries are not kept. The 1801 scan at archive.org (thinkwellontorre00chaluoft) was not needed. The text is the Wikisource volunteer transcription; the editors' markup and page numbers are dropped. Raw text in sources/en-US-originals/.
sources.tierEvidence: Bp. Richard Challoner died in 1781 and the edition is of 1801, so the text is public domain.
